evidence: risks associated with the use of artificial intelligence in our products and services

the surging buildout of artificial intelligence-related computing infrastructure has impacted and may continue to impact the availability and pricing of electronic components necessary for our business
As artificial intelligence (AI) evolves and to the extent that we use it more in our business, we may also need to train our employees to use AI effectively and/or realign certain employee roles

AI algorithms may be flawed due to a lack of back-testing or datasets of poor quality or inappropriate bias, and analyses generated by AI may be deficient or inaccurate, subjecting us to competitive or reputational harm
The use of generative AI models may result in outputs that are unpredictable, offensive, or infringe third-party rights, which could expose us to additional reputational, regulatory, or legal risks
ai_positioning.summary: Gogo adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, énumérant les risques liés à son utilisation interne (algorithmes biaisés, impacts réputationnels, défis de formation) et les impacts externes (pénuries de composants due à la course IA, paysage réglementaire complexe).
